programs.desc: Sebastian, an FBI agent, and Alex, a money launderer, are brothers on opposite sides of the law. When Alex discovers his daughter has been kidnapped, the siblings must put aside their differences to launch a rescue mission before the ransom expires.

programs.desc: When Israel Keyes is apprehended in connection to Samantha Koenig's disappearance, police have no idea that it will lead them to a string of other murders; despite promising to help authorities solve other missing persons cases and unsolved murders, Keyes is focused on controlling the narrative in the media about how he is portrayed, and the FBI must bite their tongues and suffer through the ramblings of a serial killer if they hope to find out the truth.
